mapper.select: SELECT p.difficulty, p.problem_id, p.question, COUNT(CASE WHEN a.is_correct = 0 THEN 1 END) AS wrong_attempts, -- 틀린 횟수 COUNT(*) AS total_attempts, -- 전체 시도 횟수 (COUNT(CASE WHEN a.is_correct = 0 THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS wrong_rate -- 오답률 계산 FROM tbl_attempt_details a JOIN tbl_problems p ON a.problem_id = p.problem_id WHERE p.difficulty = #{difficulty} GROUP BY p.difficulty, p.problem_id, p.question ORDER BY p.difficulty, wrong_rate DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT p.difficulty, -- 난이도 (초급/중급/고급) COUNT(a.problem_id) AS total_attempts, -- 전체 시도 횟수 COUNT(CASE WHEN a.is_correct = 1 THEN 1 END) AS correct_attempts, -- 정답 횟수 (COUNT(CASE WHEN a.is_correct = 1 THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS correct_rate -- 정답률 계산 FROM tbl_attempt_details a JOIN tbl_problems p ON a.problem_id = p.problem_id GROUP BY p.difficulty ORDER BY correct_rate DESC;

SELECT a.user_id, u.username, u.name, a.difficulty, AVG(a.total_score) AS avg_score FROM tbl_attempt_sessions a JOIN tbl_users u ON a.user_id = u.user_id JOIN tbl_class_settings c WHERE u.class_num = c.class_num GROUP BY a.user_id, u.name, a.difficulty ORDER BY u.user_id;

SELECT a.user_id, u.name, a.difficulty, a.total_score AS score, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.user_id, a.difficulty ORDER BY a.started_at) AS round FROM tbl_attempt_sessions a JOIN tbl_users u ON a.user_id = u.user_id JOIN tbl_class_settings c WHERE u.class_num = c.class_num;
